test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven people - G, H, I, J, K, L, and M are sitting in a straight line facing North.

H is sitting fourth to the left of K.

J is to the immediate right of I.

Only one person sits between M and G.

L is not an immediate neighbor of K.

H sits immediately right of M.

Who sits at the extreme left end?
solution:
Given: 

Seven people - G, H, I, J, K, L, and M are sitting in a straight line facing North.

H is sitting fourth to the left of K.

Only one person sits between M and G.

H sits immediately right of M.

J is to the immediate right of I.

L is not an immediate neighbor of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a0cb66ac45501696c9b73a63563fa4b79e7b7be810510e429683096b4674f04.png] 

So, L sits at the extreme left end.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
